settings.heading: Bring a wall to life
settings.text: Paintings, prints and sculpture chosen like an exhibition: few pieces, each given room to breathe.

settings.name: Lise Marchand
settings.quote: I paint what is left when the colour has stopped explaining itself.
settings.bio: Lise works in oil and earth pigments on large linen canvases. Her abstract fields of ochre, rust and clay are built in thin layers over several months.

settings.label: Medium
settings.text: Above a console or a bed

settings.label: Large
settings.text: Above a sofa, as a statement

settings.heading: Find the right size for your wall
settings.text: A good rule: the work should fill about two thirds of the free wall above a sofa or a console.
settings.finishes: Frames in black oak, natural oak or white

settings.heading: Hang it, lean it, live with it
settings.text: A framed print can be hung or simply leaned on a shelf. Every frame is made to order from solid oak, with museum-grade glass and a hanging kit included.

settings.quote: Better in the flesh than on screen. The colours are deeper and the frame is beautifully made.
settings.name: Sophie L.

settings.quote: Wrapped like a museum piece and it arrived without a mark. It anchors the whole living room.
settings.name: Marc D.

settings.quote: The size guide saved me from ordering too small. The etching looks perfect above the desk.
settings.name: Clara N.

settings.question: Are the works original?
settings.answer: Paintings and sculptures are unique originals. Prints and photographs are limited editions, numbered and signed on the back.

settings.question: How are works shipped?
settings.answer: Framed pieces travel in a rigid crate with corner protection. Everything is insured against loss and damage.

settings.question: Can I return a work?
settings.answer: Yes, within 14 days in its original packaging. We refund the full price once it is back with us.
